The Presidium is experiencing severe system malfunctions across the entire level. All non-emergency personnel must evacuate immediately.
We have lost all primary power to the level. Environmental controls are not responding. Class three fires are burning in sectors 2, 3, 6 and 7. Civilian casualties are high.
I am also detecting numerous unauthorized synthetic life-forms throughout the station. They are believed to be hostile. Please approach with caution.
Former Spectre agent Saren Arterius is nearing the vicinity of the Council Chamber.
A warrant has been issued for his arrest, though Citadel Security is unable to respond at this time.
In accordance with standard emergency procedures, the Council has been evacuated to the Destiny Ascension.
I have no information on the status of specific individuals. Once the current crisis has been resolved, a complete accounting of casualties and survivors will begin.
Critical failures detected across all monitored systems.
Please begin emergency evacuation procedures. This is not a drill.
